blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers has maintained that peace is measured by one country’s ability to respect its neighbors rather than purely military strength, countering remarks made by a Chinese envoy about China being able to win a conflict should it want to. Barbers, in a statement on Friday called out the Asian superpower, saying that it should pick someone its own size and stop bullying the Philippines. The former lawmaker, who is also spokesperson of the House of Representatives’ prosecution panel in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, was reacting to Chinese Ambassador […]...
